# Repository Labels

These labels should be created manually in GitHub repository settings.

## Case workflow

- `case-proposal` — a suggested backend failure case
- `needs-triage` — needs maintainer review
- `accepted-case` — accepted as a future case
- `duplicate` — already covered by another case
- `extension` — should become an extension of an existing case
- `needs-reproduction` — needs a clearer failing scenario
- `ready-to-implement` — approved and ready for implementation
- `case-implementation` — implementation work for an accepted case

## Contributor-friendly

- `good first issue` — small beginner-friendly task
- `help wanted` — external contributors are welcome
- `beginner-friendly` — safe for new contributors

## Work type

- `documentation` — README/docs improvements
- `tests` — tests or test infrastructure
- `broken-example` — broken implementation work
- `fixed-example` — fixed implementation work
- `diagram` — Mermaid/images/visual explanation
- `metadata` — case.yaml, catalog, tags, labels

## Review status

- `needs-review` — needs maintainer review
- `blocked` — cannot proceed yet
